# 8020.best

8020.best is a free, local-first task prioritizer built by Adam Pangelinan and operated through Anchor Marianas LLC. The web app turns pasted or uploaded task lists into S, A, B, C, D, and F priority tiers. A separate Chrome extension organizes saved browser tabs using the same priority model.

## Use 8020.best when

- A person wants to turn an unstructured task list into a reviewed priority system.
- A person wants portable Markdown or ZIP exports instead of a mandatory account.
- A person wants to understand the product's local storage and optional AI behavior.

## Key pages

- Home and task prioritizer: https://8020.best/
- About: https://8020.best/about
- Task deconstructor: https://8020.best/deconstructor
- Privacy policy: https://8020.best/privacy
- Support: https://8020.best/support
- Contact: https://8020.best/contact
- Public source: https://github.com/adamtpang/8020.best

## Product facts

- Price: $0.
- Account required: No.
- Web task library: Stored in browser IndexedDB.
- Requested web AI sorting: Task text is sent through 8020.best to Anthropic Claude.
- Chrome extension core library: Stored in chrome.storage.local.
- Chrome extension AI features: Optional and dependent on a separately installed local companion.
